tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Page background and every surface: cards, tiles, sheets, the tab bar. Dark is the product default.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Inset and subtle fill: inputs, segmented-control track, hover on tiles and ghost buttons, example boxes inside word cards.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 2px borders of cards and tiles, dividers, empty progress track, disabled button fill. Decorative only (1.3:1 light, 1.7:1 dark), never the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Pressed or unchecked borders (checklist circles), disabled ghost-button icon.

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders and zero-state numbers only. 2.2:1 light / 2.8:1 dark on card: below 4.5:1, so never use it for text people must read.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: subtitles, hints, captions, inactive tab labels, disabled button labels. 4.7:1 on card light, 7.5:1 dark.

tokens.name: field-edge
tokens.usage: Border of inputs and selects: 3.5:1 on card light, 3.7:1 dark (WCAG 1.4.11 for controls).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on card and paper (11:1 light, 15.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: firuze
tokens.usage: Brand turquoise. The one primary button per screen, current lesson node, unit banners, logo tile, progress fill.

tokens.name: firuze-shadow
tokens.usage: 3D bottom edge under firuze fills (buttons, current path node, logo tile).

tokens.name: firuze-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background for firuze info: the path ring around the current node, firuze callouts.

tokens.name: firuze-ink
tokens.usage: Firuze text and icons: brand name, secondary-button labels, links in firuze context. 4.6:1 on firuze-soft light, 8.2:1 dark.

tokens.name: pista
tokens.usage: Correct answer and success: Continue after a right answer, correct option border, alphabet tone.

tokens.name: pista-shadow
tokens.usage: 3D edge under pista buttons.

tokens.name: pista-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the correct feedback sheet and correct tiles.

tokens.name: pista-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on pista-soft: the correct title and detail (4.7:1 light, 8.0:1 dark).

tokens.name: anar
tokens.usage: Pomegranate red. Wrong answer, destructive actions, the active streak flame, the Speak tone.

tokens.name: anar-shadow
tokens.usage: 3D edge under anar buttons.

tokens.name: anar-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the wrong feedback sheet and wrong tiles.

tokens.name: anar-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on anar-soft; streak count; error messages (4.6:1 light, 7.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: saffron
tokens.usage: Rewards: XP star, completed path nodes, badges, Spoken tag, DEV badge. White labels on it are 2.0:1 in light: in light use saffron-ink text or a dark label, never white.

tokens.name: saffron-shadow
tokens.usage: 3D edge under saffron fills (done path nodes); the XP star outline.

tokens.name: saffron-soft
tokens.usage: Background for reward chips and the Spoken tag.

tokens.name: saffron-ink
tokens.usage: Text on saffron-soft, XP count (4.9:1 light, 8.9:1 dark).

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Selection, audio and focus: selected option border, speaker buttons, active tab, the 3px focus ring (3.1:1 on card light, 8.2:1 dark).

tokens.name: sky-shadow
tokens.usage: 3D edge under sky buttons.

tokens.name: sky-soft
tokens.usage: Selected tile background, active tab and nav item background, info callouts.

tokens.name: sky-ink
tokens.usage: Text on sky-soft: selected option, active tab label, links (5.3:1 light, 8.0:1 dark).

tokens.name: plum
tokens.usage: Grammar and the Formal tag; grammar CTA buttons and level banners.

tokens.name: plum-shadow
tokens.usage: 3D edge under plum buttons.

tokens.name: plum-soft
tokens.usage: Background for the Formal tag and grammar callouts.

tokens.name: plum-ink
tokens.usage: Text on plum-soft (6.3:1 light, 8.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label and icon colour on any solid fill (firuze, pista, anar, sky, plum). Dark mode: labels are dark, 5.7 to 9.6:1. Light mode: white is only 3.1 to 4.1:1, so keep fill labels bold and 15px or larger; flagged for a fix.

families.sans: "Nunito", "Nunito Variable", ui-rounded, "SF Pro Rounded", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Learn to read, write and speak Farsi.

styles.name: prompt
styles.usage: Session instruction line and section headings.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card titles, feedback-sheet title, stat values.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Say hello, goodbye and ask how someone is doing.
styles.usage: Running text. Weight 500 to 600; never below 500.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase labels above sections, stat-card strips, the START bubble.

styles.name: chip
styles.usage: Pill tags and counts, sentence case.

styles.name: tab-label
styles.usage: Bottom tab bar labels, sentence case (uppercase collides at 320 to 375px).

styles.name: fa-hero
styles.usage: The prompt word in a session (FaWord xl). Plain style: DOTS 0.

styles.name: fa-word
styles.usage: Word on cards and in Farsi-first mode (FaWord lg).

styles.name: fa-heading
styles.usage: Persian beside an English heading. DOTS 0 inside headings.

styles.name: fa-body
styles.usage: Example sentences and dialogue lines. Dotted style (DOTS 1). Never letter-spaced or uppercased.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons in a row, tab items.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap inside cards between title and body; grid gap for option tiles.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Side gutter on phones; padding of tiles and small cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Padding of large cards and the feedback sheet (py-5).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Vertical rhythm between page sections (space-y-6).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between hero and content blocks.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Vertical gap between path nodes.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons, icon buttons, segmented options, logo tile, nav items.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, tiles, cards, inputs, banners (rounded-2xl).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Top corners of the More bottom sheet (rounded-t-3xl).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Chips, progress bars, path nodes, avatars.

shadow.note: Farsi Pen has no soft shadows. Depth is a solid bottom edge in the fill's -shadow colour; pressing removes it and moves the element down by the same amount.

tokens.name: edge-primary
tokens.usage: Under btn-primary (firuze).

tokens.name: edge-secondary
tokens.usage: Under btn-secondary (card fill, line edge).

tokens.name: edge-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons and the logo tile (3px).

tokens.name: edge-node
tokens.usage: 72px path nodes have a deeper 6px lip.

tokens.name: edge-segment
tokens.usage: The selected option in a segmented control.

size.note: Fixed dimensions the layouts rely on.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum hit target; segmented options at least 40px.

tokens.name: button-h
tokens.usage: Default button height (btn).

tokens.name: button-h-sm
tokens.usage: btn-sm height.

tokens.name: button-h-lg
tokens.usage: btn-lg height: session Check and Continue.

tokens.name: icon-button
tokens.usage: Square icon buttons (btn-icon).

tokens.name: path-node
tokens.usage: Lesson path node diameter.

tokens.name: session-max
tokens.usage: Max width of session screens (max-w-3xl).

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: Max width of app pages (max-w-5xl).

tokens.name: sidebar-w
tokens.usage: Desktop sidebar width (lg and up).

borderWidth.note: Borders are 2px everywhere; tappable surfaces add a thicker bottom edge.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Cards, tiles, inputs, bars, dividers.

tokens.name: tile-edge
tokens.usage: Bottom border of tiles (2px when pressed).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Global focus outline in sky, offset 2px. Never remove it.
